UNAUTHORIZED OPERATOR'S GUIDE

THE SUIT IS NOT THE BOSS OF YOU.

MoveA / D · ARROWS · LEFT STICK
Jump / double jumpSPACE / W · PAD A
Snap clawJ / X · PAD X
Vent-dashK / SHIFT / C · PAD B
Overpressure burstQ / L / E · PAD Y
Drop through a ledgeDOWN + JUMP
Pause / mute / fullscreenESC / P · M · F

Hold jump to rise higher. Tap again in the air for a second jump. Dash once per airtime. Pressure refills when you stop attacking.

Bursts cost 50 charge. Hits, tags and rescues build charge. Bursts break shields and clear nearby shots. Checkpoint buoys refill hull and air.

Touch a survivor pod to rescue its occupant. All nine rescues are optional. Missing one does not lock the exit.

CLAMP CRABPatrol / stomp or snap
BUOY DRONEHover / aimed shots
BARNACLE BATTERYWatch the warning
EEL LOOTERFast / closes the gap
PRESSURE WARDENArmored / repeated snaps
TORPEDO LIFEGUARDTelegraph / charge
BUOY ENFORCERFlank / wait / burst
PUFFER BARKERSpread shots / hover
TICKET COLLECTORSturdy / terrible service

Gold tags = score. Teal canisters = pressure + charge. Green-cross packs = hull. Boss warnings mean move; recovery windows mean hit hard.
